answer: Optical scattering attestation mitigates Sybil agents by binding identities to unique physical enclosures. Verifiers prompt nodes to pulse a violet laser through a hollow tube lined with velvet baffles to record its distinct attenuation curve. Because micro-scale structural flaws cannot be simulated in software, an attacker must purchase dedicated optical hardware per identity. However, ambient dust and thermal drift alter internal reflections, causing false rejections.
